verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents a first-party webhook destination that sends event data to any HTTP endpoint, not just Slack or Discord (jitsu-docs-70, jitsu-docs-50). Users register it as a destination and choose which events flow to it by connecting sources or filtering with Functions (jitsu-docs-45, jitsu-docs-3), so a programmatic consumer can receive the event stream. Missing for 10: payload format, signing, and retry semantics for the webhook destination; webhook delivery of operational events such as sync or batch failures (documented only as email/Slack alerts); independent or hands-on corroboration.
